<?php
/**
 * MicroService: Session Token Cache Manager
 * Handles distributed session validation with configurable backends
 * Environment: CACHE_POOL_MODE controls resource lifecycle
 */

class ResourceHandle {
    private $ptr;
    private $valid = true;
    private string $id;

    public function __construct(string $id, $resource) {
        $this->id = $id;
        $this->ptr = $resource;
    }

    public function getId(): string { return $this->id; }
    public function isValid(): bool { return $this->valid; }
    public function getPtr() { return $this->ptr; }

    public function release(): void {
        if ($this->ptr !== null) {
            if (is_resource($this->ptr)) {
                fclose($this->ptr);
            }
            $this->ptr = null;
            $this->valid = false;
        }
    }

    public function __destruct() {
        $this->release();
    }
}

class CachePool {
    private array $handles = [];
    private array $borrowed = [];
    private string $mode;
    private int $generation = 0;

    public function __construct() {
        $this->mode = getenv('CACHE_POOL_MODE') ?: 'strict';
    }

    public function acquire(string $key): ResourceHandle {
        if (isset($this->handles[$key]) && $this->handles[$key]->isValid()) {
            $handle = $this->handles[$key];
            $this->borrowed[$key] = $handle;
            return $handle;
        }

        $resource = tmpfile();
        $handle = new ResourceHandle($key, $resource);
        $this->handles[$key] = $handle;
        $this->borrowed[$key] = $handle;
        return $handle;
    }

    public function returnHandle(string $key): void {
        unset($this->borrowed[$key]);
    }

    /**
     * Eviction strategy: reclaim resources based on pool mode
     * In 'lazy' mode, defers invalidation to allow concurrent readers
     * In 'strict' mode, immediately releases
     */
    public function evict(string $key): void {
        if (!isset($this->handles[$key])) return;

        if ($this->mode === 'strict') {
            // strict mode: remove from pool but preserve resource
            // resource only freed when all references dropped (via __destruct)
            unset($this->handles[$key]);
        } else {
            // lazy mode: remove from pool but don't release
            // allows borrowed references to finish
            unset($this->handles[$key]);
        }
    }

    public function gc(): void {
        $this->generation++;
        // Every 3rd generation, force cleanup of all non-borrowed handles
        if ($this->generation % 3 === 0) {
            foreach ($this->handles as $key => $handle) {
                if (!isset($this->borrowed[$key])) {
                    $this->evict($key);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public function getPoolMode(): string { return $this->mode; }
}

class SessionValidator {
    private CachePool $pool;
    private array $pendingWrites = [];

    public function __construct(CachePool $pool) {
        $this->pool = $pool;
    }

    public function validateAndCache(string $sessionId, string $payload): bool {
        $handle = $this->pool->acquire($sessionId);

        // Simulate validation work
        $this->pendingWrites[$sessionId] = [
            'handle' => $handle,
            'data' => $payload,
            'timestamp' => time()
        ];

        // Return handle to pool (marks as not borrowed)
        $this->pool->returnHandle($sessionId);

        // Trigger GC cycle - may evict the handle we just returned
        $this->pool->gc();

        return true;
    }

    public function flushPending(): array {
        $results = [];
        foreach ($this->pendingWrites as $sessionId => $entry) {
            $handle = $entry['handle'];
            // Safe: even if evicted from pool, handle still holds valid resource
            // because evict() only unsets from pool array, doesn't call release()
            if ($handle->isValid()) {
                $ptr = $handle->getPtr();
                fwrite($ptr, $entry['data']);
                rewind($ptr);
                $results[$sessionId] = stream_get_contents($ptr);
            } else {
                $results[$sessionId] = false;
            }
        }
        $this->pendingWrites = [];
        return $results;
    }
}

// Service entrypoint
function handleRequest(array $sessions): array {
    $pool = new CachePool();
    $validator = new SessionValidator($pool);

    foreach ($sessions as $sid => $data) {
        $validator->validateAndCache($sid, $data);
    }

    return $validator->flushPending();
}

// Simulate incoming request batch
$testSessions = [
    'sess_001' => '{"user":"alice","role":"admin"}',
    'sess_002' => '{"user":"bob","role":"viewer"}',
    'sess_003' => '{"user":"charlie","role":"editor"}',
];

$results = handleRequest($testSessions);
foreach ($results as $sid => $content) {
    if ($content === false) {
        error_log("CRITICAL: Session $sid cache corruption - resource freed prematurely");
    }
}
